authorization: The user explicitly chose to complete the fruit pipeline first after being told the shared SFT scored fruit 3/4 and flower 0/4.
scope: Fruit only; flower and fridge remain incomplete. The earlier two-task PPO gate was not passed and is not retroactively changed.
parent_training: One shared checkpoint trained on 64 complete fruit and flower demonstrations; no single-episode diagnostic weights are used.
algorithm: PPO using the pinned RLinf Pi0RL flow-SDE actor
required_before_training: Fresh zero-update prediction, decode, log-probability and paired closed-loop handoff check on development seed 1201.

reward.policy_input_rule: Geometry, reward and success labels never enter policy observations.

checkpoint_selection: Freeze ppo-1.pt after the single registered iteration; do not select checkpoints, seeds or hyperparameters using held-out outcomes.
evidence_required: Nonzero VLA actor gradients and actual parameter changes, SFT parent and normalization hashes, interaction counts, measured elapsed time and GPU memory.
interpretation: This is a bounded PPO experiment, not evidence of PPO convergence. Improvement is not required.
